## Brand Summary
Pretty Pocket is an online boutique based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, offering trendy cosmetics, traditional glass & velvet bangles (churi), hair accessories, and customized gift bouquets at pocket-friendly prices (most products under ৳299). Pretty Pocket provides nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD) across all 64 districts in Bangladesh.

---

---

## Delivery & Ordering Details in Bangladesh
- **Inside Dhaka**: Delivery fee is ৳70. Delivery time is 24 to 48 hours.
- **Outside Dhaka (Nationwide)**: Delivery fee is ৳130. Delivery time is 2 to 4 days via courier (Steadfast/Pathao).
- **Payment Method**: 100% Cash on Delivery (COD) available. bKash / Nagad also accepted.
- **How to Order**: Customers can place orders directly on the website, via 1-Step Fast COD Checkout, or by messaging WhatsApp at +880 1314-671743.

---

## Bangle Sizing Guide
- Size 2.4 (Small): Inner diameter 5.7 cm (2.25 inches) — Fits slender wrists and teens.
- Size 2.6 (Medium): Inner diameter 6.0 cm (2.37 inches) — Standard adult size.
- Size 2.8 (Large): Inner diameter 6.3 cm (2.50 inches) — Comfortably fits broader wrists.
